items.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I always dressed in Lily’s dressing room, he insisted on me doing that

ctx.x: I think that’s a pretty good way to put it.

That’s it for sure. And what Louis did, I meant to mention, is that when I did the Armstrong Goodman concert, he always had a little Wollensack and he would record every one of our performances. And with all the static and just done off the cuff he’d © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -7-

throw a mic on the floor someplace, backstage, and I asked him about it and he was writing his autobiography and playing the tapes the next night or whatever. And I always dressed in Lily’s dressing room, he insisted on me doing that, and that was great for me. And I got a chance to really — you know I always loved Louis and we had a great rapport. And he was listening and I remember him listening to “The Saints Go Marching In” which is a finale. And one evening he played [scats] and he liked that phrase, so he…
